verifiedText.title: Carriers of negative electricity, Nobel Lecture, 11 December 1906
verifiedText.finding: Crossed electric and magnetic forces establish velocity; subsequent electric deflection and phosphorescent displacement determine e/m. Original symbols X and H are not silently treated as present SI E and B.
verifiedText.note: The lecture contains the method and equations, not the 1897 Fig. 2 apparatus drawing. The two sources are labeled separately.

verifiedText.finding: The educational account describes cathode/anode acceleration, electric deflection plates, and magnetic coils. No e/m number is copied from the old educational pages.
